mapper.select: SELECT enabled, reward_on, referrer_stamps, friend_stamps, monthly_cap, valid_days FROM referral_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE referral_settings SET enabled = #{enabled}, reward_on = #{rewardOn}, referrer_stamps = #{referrerStamps}, friend_stamps = #{friendStamps}, monthly_cap = #{monthlyCap}, valid_days = #{validDays}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT referral_code FROM customers WHERE id = #{customerId} AND referral_code IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET referral_code = #{code} WHERE id = #{customerId} AND referral_code IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE referral_code = #{code} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(*) FROM referrals WHERE referrer_id = #{referrerId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND status <> 'LIMIT_REACHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO referrals (id, referrer_id, friend_id, status, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{referrerId}, #{friendId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT coalesce( (SELECT b.id FROM customers c JOIN branches b ON b.id = c.last_branch_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.id = #{referrerId}), (SELECT id FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE id = #{customerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'LIMIT_REACHED') AS invited, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REWARDED') AS rewarded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > #{now}) AS pending FROM referrals WHERE referrer_id = #{referrerId}

SELECT r.id, r.referrer_id, ref.name AS referrer_name, ref.phone_masked AS referrer_phone, r.friend_id, fr.name AS friend_name, fr.phone_masked AS friend_phone, CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.expires_at <= #{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE r.status END AS status, r.created_at, r.expires_at, r.rewarded_at FROM referrals r JOIN customers ref ON ref.id = r.referrer_id JOIN customers fr ON fr.id = r.friend_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REWARDED') AS rewarded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > #{now}) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= #{now}) AS expired, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'LIMIT_REACHED') AS limit_reached, (SELECT count(*) FROM stamps WHERE source = 'REFERRAL' AND status = 'CONFIRMED') AS bonus_stamps FROM referrals
